posts.name: Md Avez
posts.cooked:
I am unable to log in using my SSH key. I had previously generated and used the key successfully during BPT 1, but now during BPT 3, I am encountering the following error:

Permission denied (publickey).

Username/Host: 24f2002227@se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in

Since the OPPE exam is approaching soon, I kindly request your assistance in resolving this issue at the earliest.

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: Hi! Whenever you get permission denied error, it’s always an user side issue. You can generate a new ssh key and upload it on the passwordless website and you’ll be able to login to your VM.

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: Additionally, also make sure that the file has correct user permission (read access only to the owner r--------).
